text: If you mail in your ballot and then also vote in person, both votes get counted.

room.label: students (demo crowd)
room.note: No published poll has measured this belief yet. The 5C pilot survey replaces this split with real student answers.

truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Voting at a Polling Place after Applying to Vote by Mail
truthSource.oneLine: Only one ballot per voter counts. You trade in your mail ballot or vote provisionally, and the county checks that you didn’t vote more than once before counting it.

lesson.tip: “The system can’t catch it” claims leave out the check that does. Ask what happens between casting a ballot and counting it; official pages describe that step.
